name: Sharon A. King
service_line_reviewed: Service reviewed: Appointed April 22, 2021 through September 13, 2026. Selected decisions: 2.

biography.text: King earned a B.S. from Boston University and a J.D. from Rutgers Law School–Camden (1993). Before joining the bench, she was a partner at King & King, where her practice included civil rights, police misconduct, and wrongful-death litigation. She chaired the New Jersey State Bar Association’s Federal Practice and Procedure Section and served on the court’s Lawyers Advisory Committee.
